intro.h2: Custom cabinets in Harlingen, built to last
paragraphs: The Cabinet Shop designs, builds and installs custom cabinets in Harlingen. Customers deal with two people from the first call: Robert and Deborah, who come out to measure, listen to what you have in mind and suggest what will work in the space you have.

What stands out in the reviews is how long the work lasts and how often people come back. One family met Robert and Deborah when they built custom cabinets and a kitchen island for their kitchen. Thirteen years later, remodeling the rest of the house, their only call was to the same pair for bathroom, kitchen and laundry room cabinets.

services.h2: Custom cabinets for the whole house

items.name: Custom kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Cabinets designed for your kitchen and the space you have. One customer said Robert and Deborah listened, advised on what looked good and what worked, and delivered a beautiful, functional kitchen that will last for decades and that he now calls a piece of art.

image.alt: Grey shaker cabinets with white quartz peninsula, bar stools and stainless steel appliances

items.name: Kitchen islands
items.blurb: An island is often the centerpiece of the room. One family described the custom cabinets and amazing kitchen island The Cabinet Shop built for them, and the shop's photos include a navy blue island set against grey cabinets and open wood shelves.

image.alt: Kitchen with grey shaker cabinets, navy blue island, floating wood shelves and paneled refrigerator

items.name: Bathroom and laundry room cabinets
items.blurb: The same craftsmanship works beyond the kitchen. When a returning family remodeled their whole home, they called Robert and Deborah for custom cabinets in the bathroom, kitchen and laundry room, and nobody else. Ask about vanities and laundry storage when you call.

items.name: Design and installation
items.blurb: Robert and Deborah come out to measure, talk through what you want and suggest ideas. Reviewers say Robert is present from measurements through installation, demanding perfection from his team until the last cabinet is in place.

about.text: The Cabinet Shop is run by Robert and Deborah from 21168 FM 508 in Harlingen, Texas. Every captured review names them both. Customers describe both as welcoming from the first conversation, and one family says they both have amazing suggestions. Robert is described as extremely knowledgeable in his trade and is on site from the first measurements until the last cabinet is installed. Some clients have known them for more than a decade: one family met them 13 years before writing their review and called them again for their whole-home remodel. The shop holds 4.7 stars from 13 Google reviews.
about.owner_role: Run the shop together per Google reviews; last names and titles not published

steps.title: First call
steps.text: Call (956) 202-3893 Monday to Thursday 8 AM to 5 PM or Friday until 3 PM, and tell Robert and Deborah about your project.

steps.title: Measure and listen
steps.text: Robert and Deborah come out to measure, hear what you have in mind and suggest what looks good and works in your space.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Settle the cabinet layout, island, door style and finish together, with input from everyone who will use the kitchen.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The cabinets are built for your room. Robert and Deborah keep you updated, as reviewers say, on everything they are doing.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Robert stays on site through installation and holds his team to a high standard until the last cabinet and door are right.

testimonials.h2: What clients say about Robert and Deborah

items.name: E. J.
items.text:
The Cabinet Shop is extremely professional from start to finish.  Robert and Deborah are very welcoming from the first time I spoke to them
through getting my moms input on how she wanted her kitchen.. They communicated on everything they were doing for my mom’s new kitchen cabinets.
The Cabinet Shop team did an amazing job and my mom will definitely be reaching out to them again!  Thank you all for everything you did for my moms new kitchen 🥳 the family really enjoys it

items.name: Dee V.
items.text: We met Deborah and Robert 13 years ago when we they helped us remodel our now beautiful kitchen!! They built our beautiful custom cabinets and an amazing kitchen island. Robert is extremely knowledgeable in his trade and both he and Deborah have amazing suggestions. Robert was present from the measurements all through the installation and did not disappoint! Once again we find ourselves remodeling but this time our entire home - except my beautiful kitchen! Our only phone call was to Deborah and Robert for custom cabinets in our bathroom, kitchen and laundry room. We wouldn’t trade these 2 for the world!! They’re work is amazing, high quality and proven to last!! We highly recommend The Cabinet shop and their team!!

items.name: Jesus G.
items.text:
We are really satisfied with the design and installations of our custom cabinets by The Cabinet Shop. I had not called anybody else for a quote on our kitchen.
After Deborah and Robert came to measure and talked to us, we had no doubt they where the right company for the job. We told them what we had in mind and they listen and advised us on what looked good and what worked with the space we had.
Their vast experience guided us to a beautiful and functionable kitchen that will last for decades. When it was time for installation Robert was present till the end, demanding perfection from his team.
Now we have a piece of art displayed in our home and we are happy to recommend The Cabinet Shop to anybody that sees our kitchen.

service_area.text: The Cabinet Shop is at 21168 FM508, Harlingen, TX 78550. Google does not list a wider service area, and Robert and Deborah come to your home to measure. If you live outside Harlingen and want to know whether your project is in range, call (956) 202-3893 during shop hours and describe the rooms you want done. Hours are Monday to Thursday 8 AM to 5 PM and Friday 8 AM to 3 PM.

items.q: What rooms do you build cabinets for?
items.a: Kitchens are the main work, including custom islands, and returning customers have also had Robert and Deborah build cabinets for their bathroom and laundry room. Call (956) 202-3893 to describe your room and ask whether the shop can build what you have in mind.

items.q: Will someone come out to measure?
items.a: Yes. Reviewers describe Robert and Deborah coming out to measure and talk through the kitchen, listening to what the family had in mind and advising on what looked good and worked with the space. Robert was present from the measurements through installation.

Google lists Monday to Thursday 8 AM to 5 PM and Friday 8 AM to 3 PM. The shop is closed on Saturday and Sunday. The shop is at 21168 FM508 in Harlingen, and calling first at (956) 202-3893 is the best way to reach Robert and Deborah.

items.q: How long do your cabinets last?
items.a: One family's custom kitchen cabinets and island were still the room they loved 13 years later, when they remodeled the rest of the house but kept the kitchen. They called the work amazing, high quality and proven to last, and hired the shop again.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Call (956) 202-3893 to set up a time for Robert and Deborah to measure and talk through your project. Pricing depends on the rooms, sizes and finishes. Google's review highlights mention top quality work and very reasonable pricing. Estimate terms are not published, so ask when you call.

final_cta.text: Call The Cabinet Shop Monday to Friday and set up a time to measure.
